Zapata Quantum has entered a strategic partnership with QuEra in order to accelerate the commercial viability of quantum‐driven applications.  The collaboration focuses on developing robust, industry‑relevant solutions that draw on both companies’ expertise in software and hardware for quantum computing.  Coverage of this joint initiative is aggregated worldwide and updated continuously through Google News.
